# CloudLockFixer

> Last-checked: 2026-10-03

CloudLockFixer is a Windows tray and CLI tool for delayed rename, move and delete
operations in cloud-sync folders. It is designed for OneDrive, Dropbox, Google
Drive, Box, iCloud, Nextcloud, pCloud and Synology Drive folders where Windows
Cloud Files locks can make normal file operations fail.

Release version: 0.2.3
Current source state: unreleased multicloud, task retry/resume commands, Tier-2 6-language i18n, Spanish README, cross-platform updates, 18-point navigation parity, canonical NOTICE attribution, Four-View ASCII architectural topology projection, bilingual CONTRIBUTING guidelines, THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md Level 1 SBOM Stand 2026-10-03, Windows Store MSIX readiness, process management abstraction (Task 169), configurable exponential retry backoff (Task 172), embedded store screenshots visual showcase (Pfad B), path resilience & empty/CWD/root deletion prevention, with 353 passing tests.
Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/CloudLockFixer

Primary interfaces:
- Tray app: `START.bat` or `PYTHONPATH=src python -m cloudlockfixer`
- CLI: `PYTHONPATH=src python -m cloudlockfixer.cli` (`add`, `list`, `retry`, `retry-all`, `review-legacy-retries`, `run-now`)
- Queue file: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\CloudLockFixer\queue.txt`
- Tests: `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -ra -v`
- Source-platform smoke: `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/source_platform_smoke.py -v`

Safety boundaries:
- The tool performs destructive filesystem operations only after queued user or
  script instructions.
- Move and rename operations use copy, verify and delete fallback logic so that
  deletion happens only after a verified copy.
- Runtime queues, logs and local credentials are not part of the repository.

Key files:
- `NOTICE`: canonical open-source copyright attribution to Lukas Geiger, file-bricks and open-bricks umbrella
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: bilingual contribution guidelines, 10 governance invariants, Plan D workflow, and quality gates

- `manage_translations.py`: Tier-2 6-language auto-scanner and consistency auditor
- `locales/translations.json`: exported 6-language translation catalog
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`: formal SBOM, SPDX license audit, dynamic linking & RunAsInvoker certification
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`: plaintext dependency transparency inventory
- `MARKETING-LOG.txt`: multi-persona discovery, competition matrix, search queries & governance invariants
- `docs/DESIGN.md`: design and safety model
- `SECURITY.md`: bilingual security policy and zero-egress invariants
- `src/cloudlockfixer/paths.py`: platform-specific runtime data directory
- `src/cloudlockfixer/autostart.py`: Windows Registry, Linux XDG and macOS LaunchAgent autostart
- `src/cloudlockfixer/ops.py`: copy/delete and retry-safe filesystem operations
- `src/cloudlockfixer/providers.py`: cloud provider detection and pause policy
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: automated PEP 621, CI matrix, 18-point nav parity, and offline contract tests
- `tests/test_review_fixes_2026_07_12.py`: virtual-mount, drive-scan, retry-cap and provider-lock regressions
- `tests/source_platform_smoke.py`: headless Linux/macOS source smoke checks, including Linux XDG and macOS LaunchAgent autostart
- `tests/`: regression tests for core, i18n, provider and tray-adjacent behavior

## Audience

- Windows developers dealing with OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, iCloud, Nextcloud, pCloud or Synology Drive file-locking issues inside cloud-sync folders
- LLM agents and automation scripts that need to queue rename, move, or delete operations without encountering cldflt errors
- IT automation engineers running cloud-sync folders on managed Windows desktops who need a fire-and-forget queue
- Python/PySide6 developers looking for a reference tray tool with CLI, queue.txt, and Explorer context-menu integration

## Disambiguation

CloudLockFixer is not a generic file unlocker, antivirus utility, backup client,
ransomware recovery tool, cloud-storage SDK, or sync provider replacement. It is
a local-first delayed action queue for rename, move and delete operations that
fail because Windows Cloud Files providers temporarily lock paths.

## Last-checked: 2026-09-30

## Scoped source update: 2026-09-30

Legacy retry decisions: `clf review-legacy-retries --queue <queue.json>` reads only the specified JSON file and reports failed tasks at exactly five attempts. The old default and an intentional five-attempt limit are indistinguishable. No automatic migration; review candidates before targeted `clf retry <id>` against the active queue. Native Windows tray/autostart and new executable release gates remain open.
